text: What was the primary objective of the New Economic Policy (NEP) introduced in 1991?
options: To reduce the role of the public sector in the economy
To increase government control over the economy
To promote economic growth and liberalisation
To reduce the role of foreign investment in the economy
correctAnswer: To promote economic growth and liberalisation
explanation: The New Economic Policy (NEP) was introduced in 1991 with the primary objective of promoting economic growth and liberalisation. This policy aimed to reduce the role of the government in the economy and promote private sector growth. The policy also aimed to increase foreign investment and promote trade liberalisation.
subject: Economics

text: What is the meaning of Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation (LPG)?
options: LPG refers to the process of reducing government control over the economy
LPG refers to the process of increasing government control over the economy
LPG refers to the process of promoting economic growth and liberalisation
LPG refers to the process of promoting economic growth through liberalisation, privatisation, and globalisation
correctAnswer: LPG refers to the process of promoting economic growth through liberalisation, privatisation, and globalisation
explanation: Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation (LPG) refers to the process of promoting economic growth through liberalisation, privatisation, and globalisation. Liberalisation refers to the reduction of government control over the economy, privatisation refers to the transfer of ownership of state-owned enterprises to private individuals, and globalisation refers to the increasing integration of the world economy.
subject: Economics

text: What is the meaning of Disinvestment?
options: Disinvestment refers to the process of increasing government control over the economy
Disinvestment refers to the process of reducing government control over the economy
Disinvestment refers to the process of transferring ownership of state-owned enterprises to private individuals
Disinvestment refers to the process of reducing the role of the public sector in the economy
correctAnswer: Disinvestment refers to the process of transferring ownership of state-owned enterprises to private individuals
explanation: Disinvestment refers to the process of transferring ownership of state-owned enterprises to private individuals. This is a part of the privatisation process, where the government sells its stake in state-owned enterprises to private individuals or companies.
subject: Economics

text: What is the meaning of WTO?
options: WTO refers to the World Trade Organisation
WTO refers to the World Bank
WTO refers to the International Monetary Fund
WTO refers to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
correctAnswer: WTO refers to the World Trade Organisation
explanation: WTO refers to the World Trade Organisation, which is an international organisation that aims to promote free trade and reduce trade barriers among its member countries.
subject: Economics

text: What is the meaning of Outsourcing?
options: Outsourcing refers to the process of increasing government control over the economy
Outsourcing refers to the process of reducing government control over the economy
Outsourcing refers to the process of transferring work from one company to another
Outsourcing refers to the process of increasing the role of the public sector in the economy
correctAnswer: Outsourcing refers to the process of transferring work from one company to another
explanation: Outsourcing refers to the process of transferring work from one company to another. This can include the transfer of work from a company to a third-party provider, or from one department to another within the same company.
subject: Economics

text: What is the meaning of Financial Reforms?
options: Financial Reforms refer to the process of increasing government control over the economy
Financial Reforms refer to the process of reducing government control over the economy
Financial Reforms refer to the process of liberalising the financial sector
Financial Reforms refer to the process of increasing the role of the public sector in the economy
correctAnswer: Financial Reforms refer to the process of liberalising the financial sector
explanation: Financial Reforms refer to the process of liberalising the financial sector. This includes the removal of restrictions on foreign investment, the liberalisation of interest rates, and the promotion of competition in the financial sector.

Capital Account Convertibility refers to the process of reducing government control over the economy
Capital Account Convertibility refers to the process of liberalising the capital account

explanation: Capital Account Convertibility refers to the process of liberalising the capital account. This allows individuals and companies to convert their domestic currency into foreign currency and vice versa.
